facts.fact: The DCDT presentation to the Portfolio Committee lists Teraco Isando (Isando, Gauteng), operated by Teraco (Digital Realty), among South Africa's data centre operations, as in service in Feb 2026; owner not separately stated.

The DCDT presentation to the Portfolio Committee lists Teraco Bredell (Bredell, Gauteng), operated by Teraco (Digital Realty), among South Africa's data centre operations, as in service in Feb 2026; owner not separately stated.

The DCDT presentation to the Portfolio Committee lists Africa Data Centres Midrand (Midrand, Gauteng), operated by Africa Data Centres (ADC), among South Africa's data centre operations, as in service in Feb 2026; owner not separately stated.

The DCDT presentation to the Portfolio Committee lists Africa Data Centres Samrand (Samrand, Gauteng), operated by Africa Data Centres (ADC), among South Africa's data centre operations, as in service in Feb 2026; owner not separately stated.

The DCDT presentation to the Portfolio Committee lists Vantage Waterfall City (Waterfall City, Gauteng (80MW campus)), operated by Vantage Data Centres, among South Africa's data centre operations, as in service in Feb 2026; owner not separately stated.

The DCDT presentation to the Portfolio Committee lists Equinix JN1 (Johannesburg), operated by Equinix, among South Africa's data centre operations, as in service in Feb 2026; owner not separately stated.

The DCDT presentation to the Portfolio Committee lists Teraco Brackenfell (Brackenfell, Cape Town), operated by Teraco, among South Africa's data centre operations, as in service in Feb 2026; owner not separately stated.

The DCDT presentation to the Portfolio Committee lists Africa Data Centres Cape Town (Cape Town), operated by Africa Data Centres (ADC), among South Africa's data centre operations, as in service in Feb 2026; owner not separately stated.
The presentation names Teraco as '(Digital Realty)', a foreign group, as operator of its Isando campus, within a passage on government reliance on foreign-provided data centres.
The presentation names Teraco as '(Digital Realty)', a foreign group, as operator of its Bredell campus, within a passage on government reliance on foreign-provided data centres.

The DCDT states SITA, the State IT Agency, operates the Centurion data centre (primary of two national facilities) hosting mission-critical systems and sensitive government data; both are National Key Points.

The DCDT states SITA, the State IT Agency, operates the Beta data centre (secondary of two national facilities) hosting mission-critical systems and sensitive government data; both are National Key Points.
